title: GraphqlService
description: Scaffold a new GraphQL microservice, standalone or federated.

name.description: Service name, e.g. search (the app is created at apps/<name>-service).
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this service (e.g. search)?

datasource.description: Which datasource this service's example uses.

x-prompt.message: Which datasource should this service use?

items.label: REST — wraps an external REST API

product.description: Product this service belongs to, e.g. storefront (the service is created at apps/<product>/<name>-service and, if federated, its gateway lives at apps/<product>/gateway). Omit for a standalone service with no product owner — such a service can't be federated (--gateway must be none).
product.x-prompt: Which product does this service belong to (e.g. storefront)? Leave blank for a standalone service with no product owner.

gateway.description: Federation mode. Requires --product — a standalone service (no --product) can only be none. Omit (with --product set) to auto-detect: existing if that product's gateway is already present, otherwise none — federation is never enabled automatically.

x-prompt.message: Should this service be exposed through an Apollo Federation gateway?

items.label: Yes — create a new gateway for this product
Yes — register into this product's existing gateway
